name: demonstration
workload: the demonstration workload, docs/architecture/CAPACITY_MODEL.md section 1: 5 money movements a second for 10 minutes split in the proposed production target's proportions, reads at ten times that; the operations it names no rate for scaled from the target's peak by 5 / 10.47

operations.name: topup
operations.from: 10.6% of 5: top-ups and withdrawals, the withdrawals folded into card top-ups (reading R2: both write six events and one journal entry)

operations.name: merchant
operations.from: 11.1 a second at the target's peak, times 5 / 10.47

operations.from: two per captured card payment (W4), sent by Rehearsal.java load-callbacks, provider-driven

operations.name: settlement
operations.from: one PSP settlement file of the run's captures at mid-run, uploaded and attested through the operator edge, reconciled during the load (W5 at this scale)

operations.name: lending
operations.from: 0.5% of 5: lending repayments of EUR repaymentAmount each, to loans the harness disbursed before the load (Rehearsal.java load-lending: a policy reading no source under four eyes, the referral approved by an underwriter, the offer accepted)

operations.name: bnpl
operations.reason: 9.3% of the movements: no BNPL credit decision can approve on kind: its exposure rule reads the bureau's total balance, and no kind deployment can configure a bureau (CreditBeans refuses a URL until unresolved question 13), so the figure is unassessed and a BNPL policy's fallback declines (INV-CRD-10); a bureau on kind is an application change, routed to P16-TSK-018 (E20's simulated bureau)

operations.name: credit
operations.reason: loan credit decisions (R1): a loan decision reads the bureau and financial data, neither configurable on kind (unresolved questions 13 and 14), so every decision there is the fail-safe path, waiting its 30-minute collection window and referring: E20's subject, not the target's decision; a decision with data needs the same application change, routed to P16-TSK-018
